verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a first-class quote endpoint for fiat-to-crypto buys that returns a locked rate, fees and a signature, and the SDK executes transactions from that quote signature. The enterprise page also claims automatic fiat-to-stablecoin conversion through one API platform. Stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion appears only as a marketing line about token trading, and nothing documents settlement times. Missing for 10: documented stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion API, documented settlement times, API-level quotes and execution for crypto-to-fiat conversion, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, conversion is a first-class API — quotes and executed conversions between fiat and stablecoins (and between stablecoins) with documented rates, fees, and settlement times

citations.quote: Builds a quote for a fiat-to-crypto buy. Returns locked rate, fees, and signature for payment execution.
Quotes include fees and limits, and they expire after a short time window.
Mount the headless [Buy frame] into your UI and execute a transaction from a quote signature.
automatically convert incoming fiat into stablecoins through one API platform.
